recognize_zh: 骨髓被單一型態的中型不成熟細胞成片取代，抹片中的芽細胞染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍並帶小空泡；TCF4 核陽性，流式 CD123 強陽性合併 CD56 與 HLA-DR 陽性，符合 BPDCN，即使沒有皮膚病灶。
features: Biopsy with diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized immature cells effacing the marrow (panel A)
Aspirate blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and gray-blue cytoplasm containing small vacuoles (panel B)
Strong nuclear TCF4 staining in most neoplastic cells (panel C)
Flow cytometry: bright CD123 with CD56 coexpression (D), downregulated/partial CD303 (E), and HLA-DR positivity (F)
No granules or Auer rods in the blasts
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized immature cells replacing normal hematopoiesis. The aspirate shows blasts with fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and agranular gray-blue cytoplasm with small vacuoles. The neoplastic cells show strong nuclear TCF4 staining, and flow cytometry demonstrates a CD123-bright, CD56-positive, HLA-DR-positive population with downregulated CD303. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm extensively involving the bone marrow, notably without cutaneous disease.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (CD56+/CD123+)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML expresses CD11b, CD14, CD64, lysozyme, and often MPO and lacks the TCF4/TCL1/CD303 plasmacytoid dendritic cell program.
In this entity the pDCs are a minor mature CD34-negative population accompanying CD34+ myeloid blasts rather than the dominant neoplastic population.
These express cytoplasmic CD3, CD2, or CD7 with TdT and lack bright CD123 with TCF4.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: These pDCs are CD56 negative and cytologically mature, in contrast to these CD56-positive blastic cells.
